heroStatement: Nineteen days, four hotels, one island twice — Phuket to Krabi to Khao Lak and back to Phuket, almost exactly as planned and still full of surprises.

legs.name: Phuket (Part 1)
legs.hotel: Dinso Resort & Villas Phuket, Vignette Collection
legs.blurb: A Wabi-Sabi-inspired boutique resort on a hillside above Patong.
legs.reflection: [placeholder] Big Buddha, the jungle zipline, Bangla Road at night, a day trip to Phi Phi and James Bond Island — the trip's first taste of the Andaman coast.

legs.name: Krabi
legs.blurb: A beachfront resort on Klong Muang Beach, framed by limestone cliffs.
legs.reflection: [placeholder] Railay Beach and rock climbing, the Four Islands tour, Tiger Cave Temple, the Emerald Pool, and the Ao Nang night market.

legs.name: Khao Lak
legs.hotel: JW Marriott Khao Lak Resort & Spa
legs.blurb: A beachfront resort among tropical gardens facing the Andaman Sea.
legs.reflection: [placeholder] Phang Nga Bay by canoe, Khao Sok National Park, the Lam Ru waterfall, the tsunami memorial, and the elephant sanctuary.

legs.name: Phuket (Part 2)
legs.hotel: Phuket Marriott Resort & Spa, Merlin Beach
legs.blurb: A beachfront resort on its own secluded cove, minutes south of Patong.
legs.reflection: [placeholder] Freedom Beach, the old town, snorkeling off Racha Island, parasailing, and a last sunset at Kalim Beach.
